records.title: 10-K
records.text: We successfully managed our inventory levels, which were down 12.9% as compared to the end of fiscal 2022.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: For fiscal 2023, gross margin, inclusive of occupancy costs, was 48.4% compared to 49.9% for fiscal 2022.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: We continued to strengthen our financial position in fiscal 2023, as we generated cash flow from operations of $49.6 million and free cash flow of $32.2 million.

records.text: For the third quarter, net sales were $505.1 million compared to $518.3 million in last year’s third quarter.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: This decrease of 2.5% primarily reflects a comparable sales decrease of 2.7% since last year’s third quarter.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: At the end of the third quarter, inventories totaled $342.7 million compared to $304.1 million at the end of last year’s third quarter.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net cash provided by operating activities for the year-to-date period of fiscal 2023 was $35.5 million compared to $83.6 million in last year’s the year-to-date period.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: During fiscal 2023, total net sales decreased 11.0% compared to the prior year, with net sales in our United States, Canada and Australia segments decreasing by 16.2%, 15.0% and 11.2%, respectively, compared to the prior year, and net sales in our Europe segment increasing by 14.1% compared to the prior year.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: This includes increased product availability across all channels, faster fulfillment through ship from store offerings, and a further improved customer service experience.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The decrease in accounts payable and accrued liabilities was primarily due to the timing of payments for merchandise inventory as a result of an additional week in fiscal 2023 compared to fiscal 2022.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The decrease in gross profit is primarily attributable to the decrease in net sales, as further outlined in the net sales commentary, partially offset by a $83.5 million or 42.2%, decrease in freight expenses resulting from a decline in net sales and added cost optimizations.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: In fiscal 2023, cash flows provided by operating activities were an outflow of $203.7 million, compared with an inflow of $108.2 million in fiscal 2022.

records.title: FORM 10-K
records.text: In 2023, we reported net earnings of $134, or 0.9% of net sales, $0.82 per diluted share and EBIT of $251, or 1.8% of net sales.

records.title: FORM 10-K
records.text: Adjusted EBIT1 was $567, or 4.0% of net sales, and Adjusted EPS1 was $2.12, which exclude the impacts of charges related to the wind-down of Canadian operations and a supply chain asset impairment and related charge.

records.title: FORM 10-K
records.text: We continued to manage with leaner inventories and exited 2023 with overall ending inventory levels 3% lower than the fourth quarter of 2022 and a positive sales-to-inventory spread.

records.title: FORM 10-K
records.text: Nordstrom net sales and GMV decreased compared with 2022, which reflected a decrease in the number of items sold, partially offset by an increase in the average selling price per item sold.

records.title: FORM 10-K
records.text: Net cash used in financing activities decreased $77 between 2023 and 2022 primarily due to decreased share repurchases in 2023 compared with 2022.

records.title: 10-Q

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The year-over-year decrease was primarily driven by a benefit of 250 basis points from year-over-year AUR growth, approximately 200 basis points from lower freight costs, and approximately 200 basis points in lower levels of inventory write downs compared to last year, partially offset by 80 basis points from higher raw material costs.
